support_policy: 10.1.0 candidate with the proposed additive api-v1.5.0 contract on /api/v1. Adds scoped one-time native remote sign-in handoff, self-remote safeguards and current-device rename. RD remains disabled by default; signed grants and discovered capabilities still apply. Existing 7.0+ tunnels remain supported. Back up and test restore before deployment. The release notes identify verified and unverified coverage; final-artifact acceptance is pending. FRP follows its separate upstream version.
tested_combination_scope: historical 10.0.0 candidate only; 10.1.0 final-artifact acceptance pending
